name: Domenico Fiorillo
bioAdditions: Domenico died at San Mango on 6 June 1849 and was buried the next day. His age was given as 74, so he was born about 1775, and his birthplace as Cannovali, a hamlet of Aiello Calabro (S1, S2). This makes him about ten years older than the tree's 1785. Both death records name his father as the late Carmine (Gabriele) Fiorillo. His mother's given name is Giacinta ('Cintia') in both, but her surname is uncertain: 'Feraculo' in the civil act, Iera in the parish index (S1, S2). A probable brother, Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo (d. 1853), is recorded as son of Carmine and Giacinta Marrello (S5). His wife Maria Marrello died in 1846 (S3). The family's absence from San Mango's 1674-1804 stati delle anime is explained: the Fiorillos were Aiello people who moved down the Savuto valley in the early 1800s.

conflicts.assessment: Ages at death are approximate; the two independent records agree on 74.
